author: PieZ
body:
Yes others have different opinions but when I see 2 people or more in a flame war, the topic comes out either being locked or a user leaving for a week. There is no spank or indication that a player has done wrong. A warn or a temp forum ban could at least be done

Also this is after the "Let's have a tourny" thread got locked :L

replies.body:
The staff may be careful if they do start punishing people though because there is a fine line between a debate -> argument -> flamewar.

Once the people are civil, I wouldn't consider it a flamewar personally. I consider a flamewar when people get personal or start getting rude and whatnot.
